primitive.relation: definitional equality: U11's undirected deletion-deck vocabulary vdel_card v (induced [set u | u != v]), same_deck / reconstructible (a bijection of the vertex sets matching the cards up to isomorphism, so every card keeps its multiplicity) and same_edge_deck / edge_reconstructible (a bijection of the edge index types {e | e \in E(G)} matching the edge-deleted cards up to isomorphism) are the public Reconstruction.foundations.decks definitions, the same bodies; the edge card is A4's canonical del_edge_set G [set e], of which U11's sdel_edge G e is a transparent alias. No guard lives in a definition: the three-vertex guards (on G and H), the four-edge guard (on G only) and the Whitney premise's hypotheses stay in the statements. Digraph P9's same_deck (directed carrier, deleted-vertex cards compared modulo arc-reversal switching) shares the short name only and is not migrated; U11's Seidel switching deck, X21's ell-decks and kelly's public boundary (D2) are separate.

undirected-deletion-decks.verdict: conversion (the same bodies; the edge card del_edge_set G [set e] is U11's sdel_edge G e)
undirected-deletion-decks.note: U11 keeps its five names, binders and implicit arguments (vdel_card keeps G implicit) as transparent aliases (decks required without Import); statements, doc blocks and guards unchanged.

directed-switching-deck.verdict: distinct representation: digraph carrier, deleted-vertex cards compared modulo arc-reversal switching (sw_iso), not graph isomorphism
directed-switching-deck.note: Kept distinct by master decision; the directed switching-deck predicates form a later separate family. Unchanged here (distinct_variants in the spec).

upstream_audit.note: Reused from Marcol's contract (reconstruction-decks-contract-by-marcol.md c2187520, erratum cc4b9a9d) and kept: the pinned GraphTheory 0.9.7 / MathComp have no deck, reconstruction or vertex-deletion-card vocabulary (only multigraph and pre-graph remove_vertex and a directed-arc del_edge, all different carriers), and no public owner of the five names exists; induced, bijective, diso, E(G) and GTBase.common.del_edge_set are reused unchanged, and upstream's induced [set~ v] is reached through the proved equation vdel_cardE, never assumed convertible. Rejected as deck primitives: mgraph/pre-graph remove_vertex, digraph del_edge and del_vertex, base line_graph, P9's directed switching deck, X21's ell-decks and a set-of-isomorphism-classes model (which loses multiplicity).
